youtube.caption:
Henry VIII had an official royal butt-wiper… and it was one of the most powerful jobs in England. 🧻

Would YOU take the job for a castle? Yes or no 👇

Parody · fictional chat. Based on history: the Groom of the Stool attended the Tudor king on his "close stool" (a padded toilet box). Sir William Compton held the post for Henry VIII for years, became one of his closest confidants, handled the king's private money and ended up a knight with huge estates.
